request:
镜头 s21：纪录片中引用的旧资料影像，时长 8 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
年代与画面风格（detailed_description 第一行照此英文书写）：archival 2058 broadcast news footage from a shoulder-mounted ENG camera recorded on tape: interlaced softness, faint scan lines, chroma smear on reds, clipped hot whites, crushed murky shadows, compression noise, urgent imperfect framing
该类型的纪录片默认机位：archival footage quoted inside a documentary
导演意图（自然语言）：潜水头盔摄像机画面，水下，黑暗，浑浊。头灯的光柱照着淹没的服务器机柜，一只戴手套的手伸向接口面板，用力插上。对讲机里传来宋工失真的声音。环境声：沉闷的呼吸声、气泡声、对讲机电流声。
情绪：claustrophobic, tense, heroic
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：point-of-view helmet camera, floating unsteadily underwater
景深与虚实：Murky water haze, only the panel and the glove sharp in the lamp beam.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Archival helmet-camera frame underwater in the flooded root-server hall: dark murky water, beams of helmet lamps cutting through silt between submerged server racks, a gloved hand reaching for a connector panel. Blocking lock: the submerged server rack fills frame right, the connector panel at frame centre, the gloved hand enters from frame lower left; helmet lamp beams sweep from the top.
Picture 2: Engineer Song at 43 (2058, the restart operation) (character reference; role: the protagonist). The same man ten years later, 43: the same face, mole and thin round steel-rimmed glasses, now grey at the temples, short stubble, a thinner face with deeper lines and tired eyes. Dark olive engineering field jacket with reflective strips over a black thermal undersuit.
Picture 3: the staging area of the 2058 root-server restart operation (location reference; role: location reference). A staging area at the edge of a flooded underground root-server facility in 2058: floodlights on tripods glaring off black water that covers the floor, concrete pillars, coils of cable, open equipment cases, diving helmets and air tanks on a tarp, a temporary railing at the water's edge. Empty of people, urgent, cold.
台词（逐字照抄，按顺序，每句放进一个 <d>[Chinese] ...</d>）：
1. Song (a man in his forties, voice distorted through a diving-helmet radio, breathing hard) — 宋工（四十多岁男性的声音，从潜水头盔对讲机里传出，失真、喘着气）: 最后一组。我来。
现场环境声：heavy breathing in a helmet, bubbles, crackling radio static
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

detailed_description:
16:9 horizontal, single clip 8.0s, 24fps, archival 2058 broadcast news footage from a shoulder-mounted ENG camera recorded on tape: interlaced softness, faint scan lines, chroma smear on reds, clipped hot whites, crushed murky shadows, compression noise, urgent imperfect framing; real documentary footage, not a movie, not CGI, unposed; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, point-of-view helmet camera, floating unsteadily underwater, drifting very slowly forward from a wide view of the submerged rack to a medium view of the connector panel. pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut.
Blocking at the start: submerged server rack fills frame right, connector panel at frame centre, the gloved hand entering from frame lower left, lamp beams sweeping down from the top of frame, open murky water frame left.
Start: the helmet camera rocks and settles, the lamp beam swinging across silt between the racks, silt motes drifting through the cone of light, the connector panel swimming into view at frame centre. Middle: the gloved hand comes in from frame lower left, fingers spread, hovers over the small round ports, wipes a film of silt off the socket with the side of the thumb, then brings the heavy cable-end connector up; the camera tilts down to follow the hand, breathing shakes the frame, bubbles rise past the lens. End: the glove braces against the cabinet, shoves the connector straight into the socket with a hard push, the hand staying pressed there, the beam settling on the seated connector and the murk closing back in around the light.
Mood: claustrophobic, tense, heroic. Blur: murky water haze everywhere, only the connector panel and the glove sharp inside the lamp beam, the rack edges and frame left dissolving into soft brown-green murk, the far end of the hall invisible.
Song (a man in his forties, voice distorted through a diving-helmet radio, breathing hard) says, <d>[Chinese] 最后一组。我来。</d> Final line of this shot: end on "我来", complete the whole sentence, no cut-off; after the last line nobody speaks. Hold the last frame.

overall_soundscape:
Heavy breathing inside the helmet, bubbles rising past the microphone, crackling radio static, muffled water pressure against metal, a wet metallic clunk as the connector seats, the low thrum of the flooded hall; raw production location sound only, dry and unscored, no background music.
